description: 8 retrieval probes for axios/axios — an MIT-licensed pure-JS HTTP client library with class-based architecture, prototype-assignment HTTP-verb metaprogramming, static factory methods, and class extension (AxiosError extends Error).

probes.query: how does axios apply request and response interceptors in the dispatch chain
probes.notes: NL behavior probe: InterceptorManager class (line 5) holds the interceptor chain — core of how axios composes middleware around the request

probes.query: how does axios serialize URL search parameters with custom encoding
probes.notes: NL behavior probe: buildURL (line 31) takes a URL + params and constructs the final querystring — the answer to how axios encodes params

probes.query: how does axios cancel an in-flight request using a cancel token
probes.notes: NL behavior probe: CancelToken class (line 12) is the cancellation API — Promise-based wakeup signal that the dispatcher checks

probes.query: Axios class request method that runs the configured request
probes.notes: Symbol-anchored probe: Axios.request (line 39) is the public async-method entry point that wraps _request
Symbol-anchored probe: AxiosHeaders class (line 80) provides set/get/has/delete on a normalized header bag with static factory methods (from/concat/accessor)

probes.query: buildFullPath function combining baseURL and request URL
probes.notes: Symbol-anchored probe: buildFullPath joins baseURL + relative URL — small, signature-anchored target

probes.query: Axios prototype dynamic method assignment for HTTP verbs get post put delete
probes.notes: Grammar-edge-case probe: lines 240-275 assign Axios.prototype[method] inside utils.forEach callbacks for both safe (get/delete/head/options) and unsafe (post/put/patch) HTTP verbs. Exercises tree-sitter-javascript chunker's handling of prototype-assignment metaprogramming — the chunker should still attribute these to the Axios class, not split them as standalone functions

probes.query: AxiosError class extending Error with constructor accepting message code config
probes.notes: Grammar-edge-case probe: AxiosError (line 75) is `class AxiosError extends Error` with an Object.setPrototypeOf in the constructor + custom `captureStackTrace` handling. Exercises tree-sitter's handling of class extension via the `extends` keyword and downstream constructor-with-super patterns
